annotations.title: How many pages will it be

description: The estimated page count of a printed issue: cover, contents, frontispiece, each essay from its words and images, and a back page, rounded up to a multiple of 4, and whether it fits a stapled magazine (80 pages). The issue page gives the exact count once laid out. Example questions: how many pages would my essays make; will 12 posts fit in one issue; how long would the magazine be.
